held.title: Interpolating before querySupportsSplitting may defeat the range-variable check
held.body: `querySupportsSplitting` skips splitting when `isQueryWithRangeVariable(query.expr)` is true, because the backend interpolates `$__range` against each split time range. Interpolation now runs first. If `applyTemplateVariables` or the template service replaces `$__range` (or similar), the check always sees a concrete value. Queries that used to be sent unsplit are then split, and each chunk uses the full-range value, which gives wrong results. I could not see what `applyTemplateVariables` does with `$__range`. Either run the range-variable check on the original targets, or keep those variables untouched during the initial interpolation.
